problem: The response indicator was a generic black three-dot bounce with weak contrast and insufficient visual identity.
solution: Replaced it with a white signal-pulse: three 7.2-point nodes, exactly 20 percent larger than the previous 6-point dots, joined by a thin rail with a phased active ring. The existing centered single-loader policy remains authoritative, and reduced-motion mode renders a static signal without an owned repeating timer.
lesson: A distinctive loader can remain quiet and functional: one system-driven phase, a small network metaphor, strict contrast, exact scale tokens, and reduced-motion support communicate agent activity without adding another status surface.
